label: Dubstep / Brostep (Mid-Range, Festival)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 140-150 BPM, felt half-time 70-75 BPM
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: A cinematic, ominous intro builds with a rising riser and a chopped vocal word before a fake-out pause. The first drop hits with a snarling, talking bass riff, a breakdown brings a calm synth motif and tension, and a harder second drop…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Short, clipped vocal one-shots, such as hype shouts and single words, are cut into the build-ups as rhythmic punctuation.
cards.palette: A mid-range bass riff made from layered saw waves with formant filtering and heavy distortion talks and snarls in call-and-response phrases through both drops, over a clean sine sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM

cards.mood: Defiant and high-energy from the first bar: a short shouted intro, a pre-chorus that tightens with snare rolls, then a huge drop where the bass answers the voice. A stripped bridge leaves only the vocal and a pulsing sub before the final,…
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male). The vocalist possesses a gritty, mid-range tenor timbre with a raw, urgent edge.
cards.palette: Aggressive, distorted mid-bass riffs answer each vocal line in the drops, alternating a rasping growl and a high metallic screech over a heavy sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 150 BPM, felt half-time as 75 BPM

cards.mood: Starts intimate and dark, with a sparse verse over a heavy sub. The pre-chorus builds with a rising riser and snare rolls, and the hook explodes into a crushing drop where the chopped vocal becomes part of the bass riff. A quiet bridge…
cards.vocal: Singer A (Female). The vocalist possesses a clear, breathy, airy soprano timbre with a soft, intimate lower register.
cards.palette: A growling, distorted mid-bass lead plays the drop riff while a clean sub holds the root. In the verses a soft pluck synth plays a minor arpeggio.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM
